newsitem.title: FRANCE: Poll shows French 1997 EPS forecasts up 0.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Poll shows French 1997 EPS forecasts up 0.3 pct.

text.p: Associes en Finance said that the consensus of 1997 earnings per share forecasts for French companies was 0.3 percent higher at mid-April compared with the previous month.
For the CAC-40 blue-chip shares there was a decline of 0.1 percent due to heavy downgrades on Renault.
Associes en Finance, who polled 18 forecasters, said that on a weighted basis, the average for the CAC-40 was up 0.8 percent.
It said that the expected total profit of companies in 1997 was two percent higher in April than in December with a rise in the CAC-40 profits in 1997 and 1998 of 16.3 percent.
